name: Find Animation Opportunities
author: Emil Kowalski
description: A disciplined motion audit and filter based on Emil Kowalski's animation philosophy. Acts as a filter, not a wishlist. Proposes high-conviction micro-interactions with exact durations and easings.
hard_rules: Filter First: Reject most candidates. A short list of high-impact animations beats an over-animated, sluggish interface
No Decoration on Dense Functional UI: Data tables, charts, and information displays must stay static and legible

gate_1_frequency.100_plus_times_a_day: Reject. Instant execution only (keyboard shortcuts, command palettes, primary nav)
gate_1_frequency.tens_of_times_a_day: Suggest only near-imperceptible motion (<150ms) (toggle switches, list row clicks)
gate_1_frequency.occasional: Eligible for standard animation (modals, dialogs, sheets, toast notices)
gate_1_frequency.rare_or_first_time: Eligible for delight budget (onboarding steps, milestone celebration)

gate_2_purpose: Feedback: Confirming user intent (button press scale)
Spatial Consistency: Showing origin/destination (sheet expands from trigger, toast slides from bottom)
State Indication: Making change legible (chevron rotation on expand)
Preventing Jarring Change: Bridging visual pop-in or layout jumps

gate_3_speed_budgets.hard_ceiling: UI motion must stay under 300ms total. Anything requiring slow, showy timing is rejected.

four_question_gate.gate_4_function: Does motion clarify or distract? If it adds cognitive drag, reject.

deliverables: Recipe (exact duration, CSS cubic-bezier / Framer Motion spring)
